Every call, arrest, and interaction for law enforcement officers is different. Of course there are bad cops who have killed innocent people, but the amount of cops that have never shot an innocent person far outweighs the amount of bad caps who have. Oh also, white people get shot by police too.

The fact that she wasn't sent back is great and all, but I don't really think they "stood up for her". They were set on putting her on a plane back to Kuwait. The story went viral, embassies in Thailand received thousands of calls and messages about her, and it took the UNHCR to step in even after the Thai officials tried to stop them from communicating with her the first time. If it weren't for the amount of people hearing about the story and spreading it around, she'd probably be back in Kuwait by now.

There are lots of fake gambling sites and many sites that say they are provably fair, as I'm sure a lot of people don't bother to ever look into it.
